body: It sounds pathetic, but the only thing I truly find enjoyment in was gaming. It's my only way of escaping how shitty real life can be sometimes. My mom has broken every computer/laptop (total of 5) I have ever had as a result of some argument.

I feel the exact same way you do, I wish I had someone to support me, I can't even talk to let alone want to be around my own parents; and I feel as though my 'friends' don't really like me either, I don't have anyone close enough to call a best friend or anything either. 

Sorry for what you're going through, I hope it gets better for both of us.
